Elena (CS): Quick weekly pulse for SummitAI before renewal planning. Onboarding at 82%, spend up 6% driven by embed volume. Noticed p99 blips on /completion non-stream yesterday afternoon. Sharing p95/p99 by route+model and streaming vs non-streaming.

Sam (Solutions): please paste the table and any short notes about root cause so we can recommend defaults.

Elena (CS): rolling 7d aggregates below (latency ms, err%, daily reqs).

```
route       model      mode         p95  p99   err%  req/day
/chat       t7-nano    streaming    195  680   0.18  24k
/chat       t7-nano    non-stream   420 1200  0.9   2.8k
/completion gpt-std    sync         640 1900  2.4   4.6k
/embed      pico       streaming     48  130   0.02  63k
/rerank     llama3     non-stream   1020 2800  3.1   900
```

Jorge (SRE): rerank tail correlates with large batch reranks + occasional retry storms. For completion p99 we saw a couple client retries that amplified tail at 15:22 UTC.

Mina (Customer): Confirmed  we had a background job that retried 3x due to a transient 503. This hit at 15:20 and affected a small subset of users.

Sam (Solutions): Streaming clearly tightens both p95 and p99 for chat. Recommend defaulting to stream=true for /chat and adding prefix cache for repeated system prompts.

Elena (CS): Action items:
- Sam: draft a short note for the customer's devs explaining streaming benefits + code snippet by Tue.
- Jorge: inspect rerank memory OOMs and add temporary pool headroom; open INC if >=3 OOMs.
- Elena: include embed budget cap options and renewal talking points in the packet to Mina.

PagerBot: Ticket CH-2026-5519 created: "SummitAI rerank tail & completion retry amplification" assigned to Jorge.

Sam (Solutions): Quick curl example to enable streaming for chat:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{\"route\":\"/chat\",\"model\":\"t7-nano\",\"stream\":true}'
```

Mina (Customer): I'll flip streaming in staging tonight and run the synthetic test against p99 window. Also please send the embed cap options.

Elena (CS): Thanks everyone  I'll send the renewal prep doc after Sam's note lands. Next mini-sync Thursday 8:30am PT. :calendar:
